prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1330; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in a collision that occurred in a parking lot and involved a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. Our client has been advised to make no statements to any representative of your company.

We request that you provide the policy limits for all coverages applicable to the insured vehicle and driver, including bodily injury liability and any available excess or umbrella coverage. Please confirm in writing the policy number, the effective coverage period, and the identity of the claims adjuster assigned to this file.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics and event data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any incident or claim reports. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials until this matter is fully resolved.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm your compliance with these requests within fourteen days of your receipt.
